src = open('t_bounds.py').read()
old = """# header block exactly 32768
base = req()
hb_len = len(base.split(b'\\r\\n\\r\\n')[0])
pad = 32768 - hb_len - len('X: \\r\\n')
w = req(extra=['X: ' + 'p' * pad])
chk('hblock exactly 32768', len(w.split(b'\\r\\n\\r\\n')[0]) == 32768, len(w.split(b'\\r\\n\\r\\n')[0]))

)
chk('hblock 32769 rejected', out['results'][0]['reason'] == 'syntax', out['results'][0])"""
new = """# header block exactly 32768 (built from several <=8192-byte lines)
def sized_hblock(target):
    base = req()
    hb_len = len(base.split(b'\\r\\n\\r\\n')[0])
    extra = []
    need = target - hb_len
    i = 0
    while need > 0:
        take = min(need - 2 - len('X%d: ' % i), 8000)
        if take < 1:
            return None
        line = 'X%d: ' % i + 'p' * take
        need -= len(line) + 2
        extra.append(line)
        i += 1
    return req(extra=extra) if need == 0 else None
w = sized_hblock(32768)
chk('hblock exactly 32768 built', w is not None and len(w.split(b'\\r\\n\\r\\n')[0]) == 32768,
    None if w is None else len(w.split(b'\\r\\n\\r\\n')[0]))
out = run(envelope([ev(0, wire=w)]))
chk('hblock 32768 accepted', out['results'][0]['decision'] == 'accept', out['results'][0])
w = sized_hblock(32770)
chk('hblock 32770 built', w is not None and len(w.split(b'\\r\\n\\r\\n')[0]) == 32770)
out = run(envelope([ev(0, wire=w)]))
chk('hblock 32770 rejected', out['results'][0]['reason'] == 'syntax', out['results'][0])"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)
open('t_bounds.py','w').write(src)
